ck_supplier_lifecycle_close.name: ck_supplier_lifecycle_close
ck_supplier_lifecycle_close.value:
("supplier_lifecycle_cases"."status" = 'open' AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."outcome" IS NULL AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."closure_note" IS NULL AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."closed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("supplier_lifecycle_cases"."status" = 'closed' AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("supplier_lifecycle_cases"."closure_note")) >= 5 AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "supplier_lifecycle_cases"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_bin_movement_has_endpoint.name: ck_bin_movement_has_endpoint
ck_bin_movement_has_endpoint.value: "bin_movements"."from_bin_id" IS NOT NULL OR "bin_movements"."to_bin_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_bin_movement_distinct_endpoints.name: ck_bin_movement_distinct_endpoints
ck_bin_movement_distinct_endpoints.value: "bin_movements"."from_bin_id" IS NULL OR "bin_movements"."to_bin_id" IS NULL OR "bin_movements"."from_bin_id" <> "bin_movements"."to_bin_id"

ck_data_product_outcome_currency.name: ck_data_product_outcome_currency
ck_data_product_outcome_currency.value: ("data_product_outcome_events"."cash_impact" IS NULL AND "data_product_outcome_events"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("data_product_outcome_events"."cash_impact" IS NOT NULL AND "data_product_outcome_events"."currency" = 'CNY')

ck_data_product_outcome_reason_required.name: ck_data_product_outcome_reason_required
ck_data_product_outcome_reason_required.value: "data_product_outcome_events"."decision" NOT IN ('modified', 'rejected') AND "data_product_outcome_events"."result" NOT IN ('negative', 'false_positive') OR "data_product_outcome_events"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL

ck_data_product_release_decision.name: ck_data_product_release_decision
ck_data_product_release_decision.value:
("data_product_releases"."status" = 'pending' AND "data_product_releases"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "data_product_releases"."decided_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("data_product_releases"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'revoked') AND "data_product_releases"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "data_product_releases"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_data_product_release_revocation.name: ck_data_product_release_revocation
ck_data_product_release_revocation.value:
("data_product_releases"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "data_product_releases"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "data_product_releases"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("data_product_releases"."status" = 'revoked' AND "data_product_releases"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "data_product_releases"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_integration_run_terminal.name: ck_integration_run_terminal
ck_integration_run_terminal.value:
("integration_runs"."status" = 'running' AND "integration_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("integration_runs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "integration_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_month_close_completion.name: ck_month_close_completion
ck_month_close_completion.value: ("month_close_checks"."status" = 'pending' AND "month_close_checks"."completed_by" IS NULL AND "month_close_checks"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("month_close_checks"."status" IN ('completed', 'waived') AND "month_close_checks"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "month_close_checks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_sop_cycle_lifecycle.name: ck_sop_cycle_lifecycle
ck_sop_cycle_lifecycle.value:
("sop_cycles"."status" = 'consensus' AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_by" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_at" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_by" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_at" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("sop_cycles"."status" = 'frozen' AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_by" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_at" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("sop_cycles"."status" = 'executing' AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("sop_cycles"."status" = 'closed' AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."executing_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sop_cycles"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_electronic_label_previous.name: ck_electronic_label_previous
ck_electronic_label_previous.value: ("electronic_label_versions"."version" = 1 AND "electronic_label_versions"."previous_id" IS NULL) OR ("electronic_label_versions"."version" > 1 AND "electronic_label_versions"."previous_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_quality_action_completion.name: ck_quality_action_completion
ck_quality_action_completion.value:
("quality_actions"."status" = 'open'
        AND "quality_actions"."completed_by" IS NULL AND "quality_actions"."completed_at" IS NULL
        AND "quality_actions"."evidence_ref" IS NULL AND "quality_actions"."outcome" IS NULL)
      OR ("quality_actions"."status" <> 'open'
        AND "quality_actions"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_actions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("quality_actions"."evidence_ref", ''))) >= 3
        AND length(trim(coalesce("quality_actions"."outcome", ''))) >= 3)

ck_quality_action_verification.name: ck_quality_action_verification
ck_quality_action_verification.value:
("quality_actions"."status" IN ('open', 'completed')
        AND "quality_actions"."verified_by" IS NULL AND "quality_actions"."verified_at" IS NULL
        AND "quality_actions"."verification_note" IS NULL)
      OR ("quality_actions"."status" IN ('verified', 'ineffective', 'waived')
        AND "quality_actions"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_actions"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("quality_actions"."verification_note", ''))) >= 5)

ck_quality_action_sod.name: ck_quality_action_sod
ck_quality_action_sod.value: "quality_actions"."verified_by" IS NULL OR "quality_actions"."completed_by" IS NULL OR "quality_actions"."verified_by" <> "quality_actions"."completed_by"

ck_quality_case_reportable_fields.name: ck_quality_case_reportable_fields
ck_quality_case_reportable_fields.value:
"quality_cases"."assessment" <> 'serious_reportable'
      OR ("quality_cases"."kind" = 'adverse_event' AND "quality_cases"."report_policy" IS NOT NULL
        AND "quality_cases"."report_due_date" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_cases"."retention_until" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("quality_cases"."assessment_basis", ''))) >= 5)

ck_quality_case_recall_scope.name: ck_quality_case_recall_scope
ck_quality_case_recall_scope.value:
"quality_cases"."kind" <> 'recall' OR "quality_cases"."status" = 'open'
      OR ("quality_cases"."scope_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_cases"."scope_digest" IS NOT NULL
        AND "quality_cases"."scope_frozen_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_quality_case_self_inspection.name: ck_quality_case_self_inspection
ck_quality_case_self_inspection.value:
"quality_cases"."kind" <> 'self_inspection'
      OR ("quality_cases"."inspection_year" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_cases"."inspection_year" >= 2020
        AND length(trim(coalesce("quality_cases"."inspection_site", ''))) >= 2
        AND "quality_cases"."inspection_site_key" = upper(regexp_replace(trim("quality_cases"."inspection_site"), '\s+', ' ', 'g')))

ck_quality_case_non_inspection_fields.name: ck_quality_case_non_inspection_fields
ck_quality_case_non_inspection_fields.value:
"quality_cases"."kind" = 'self_inspection'
      OR ("quality_cases"."inspection_year" IS NULL AND "quality_cases"."inspection_site" IS NULL
        AND "quality_cases"."inspection_site_key" IS NULL AND "quality_cases"."inspection_report_ref" IS NULL
        AND "quality_cases"."inspection_report_date" IS NULL)

ck_quality_case_self_inspection_report.name: ck_quality_case_self_inspection_report
ck_quality_case_self_inspection_report.value:
"quality_cases"."kind" <> 'self_inspection'
      OR (("quality_cases"."inspection_report_ref" IS NULL AND "quality_cases"."inspection_report_date" IS NULL)
        OR ("quality_cases"."inspection_report_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_cases"."inspection_report_date" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quality_cases"."retention_until" IS NOT NULL))

ck_quality_case_close.name: ck_quality_case_close
ck_quality_case_close.value:
("quality_cases"."status" <> 'closed' AND "quality_cases"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "quality_cases"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "quality_cases"."closure_note" IS NULL)
      OR ("quality_cases"."status" = 'closed' AND "quality_cases"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "quality_cases"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce("quality_cases"."closure_note", ''))) >= 5)

ck_regulatory_previous.name: ck_regulatory_previous
ck_regulatory_previous.value: ("regulatory_records"."version" = 1 AND "regulatory_records"."previous_id" IS NULL) OR ("regulatory_records"."version" > 1 AND "regulatory_records"."previous_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_data_quality_reviews_reviewed.name: ck_data_quality_reviews_reviewed
ck_data_quality_reviews_reviewed.value: ("data_quality_reviews"."status" = 'pending' AND "data_quality_reviews"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "data_quality_reviews"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("data_quality_reviews"."status" <> 'pending' AND "data_quality_reviews"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "data_quality_reviews"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_department_goals_actual_pair.name: ck_department_goals_actual_pair
ck_department_goals_actual_pair.value: ("department_goals"."actual_value" IS NULL AND "department_goals"."actual_source" IS NULL) OR ("department_goals"."actual_value" IS NOT NULL AND "department_goals"."actual_source" IS NOT NULL)

ck_ops_plan_events_target.name: ck_ops_plan_events_target
ck_ops_plan_events_target.value: "ops_plan_events"."sku_id" IS NOT NULL OR "ops_plan_events"."spu_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_sales_amount_monthly_scope_id.name: ck_sales_amount_monthly_scope_id
ck_sales_amount_monthly_scope_id.value: ("sales_amount_monthly"."scope_kind" = 'company' AND "sales_amount_monthly"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("sales_amount_monthly"."scope_kind" <> 'company' AND "sales_amount_monthly"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_sku_planning_policy_override_pair.name: ck_sku_planning_policy_override_pair
ck_sku_planning_policy_override_pair.value: ("sku_planning_policy"."override_tier" IS NULL AND "sku_planning_policy"."override_by" IS NULL) OR ("sku_planning_policy"."override_tier" IS NOT NULL AND "sku_planning_policy"."override_by" IS NOT NULL)

ck_transfer_fees_sign.name: ck_transfer_fees_sign
ck_transfer_fees_sign.value: ("transfer_fees"."reversal_of_id" IS NULL AND "transfer_fees"."amount" >= 0) OR ("transfer_fees"."reversal_of_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transfer_fees"."amount" < 0)
